source.name: Hand-built, checked row by row against English Wikipedia

country.match: Match each lake to its country.
country.odd: Three of these lakes are in {value}. Which one isn't?

rows.label: Lake Ontario
rows.description: one of the Great Lakes in North America
rows.hook: catches the flow of a thundering waterfall shared by two countries

rows.label: Lake Baikal
rows.description: freshwater rift lake in southern Siberia, Russia; the greatest mountain lake in Asia and the most voluminous freshwater lake in the world
rows.hook: plunges deeper than anywhere else on Earth's surface

rows.label: Caspian Sea
rows.description: largest landlocked salt lake, located between Europe and Asia
rows.hook: ranks as the largest lake on Earth, though its waters are salty

rows.label: Lake Superior
rows.description: largest of the Great Lakes of North America
rows.hook: holds more fresh water than its four neighboring giants put together

rows.label: Lake Erie
rows.description: one of the Great Lakes in North America
rows.hook: freezes over more completely most winters than its deeper neighbors

rows.label: Dead Sea
rows.description: lake with no outflow (sea) in Western Asia
rows.hook: gets so salty that swimmers float on the surface without trying

rows.label: Lake Michigan
rows.description: one of the Great Lakes of North America
rows.hook: sits completely inside a single country, unlike its neighboring giants

rows.label: Lake Tahoe
rows.description: lake in California and Nevada, United States
rows.hook: draws visitors to its clear blue alpine waters ringed by ski resorts

rows.label: Lake Como
rows.description: lake in Lombardy, Italy
rows.hook: attracts celebrities to elegant villas amid the Alps

rows.label: Lake Titicaca
rows.description: Alpine lake in Peru and Bolivia
rows.hook: hosts floating islands woven entirely from reeds by local islanders

rows.label: Lake Huron
rows.description: one of the Great Lakes of North America
rows.hook: has a shoreline longer than any of its sister waters, dotted with islands

rows.label: Lake Victoria
rows.description: lake in east-central Africa
rows.hook: feeds the source of one of the world's longest rivers

rows.label: Crater Lake
rows.description: caldera lake in south-central Oregon and main feature of Crater Lake National Park
rows.hook: has no rivers flowing in or out, fed only by rain and snow

rows.label: Lake Maggiore
rows.description: lake in Italy and Switzerland
rows.hook: surrounds a cluster of small islands famous for ornate palace gardens

rows.label: Loch Ness
rows.description: lake in Highland, Scotland, UK, outflows via Loch Dochfour to the River Ness and Caledonian Canal
rows.hook: hosts legends of a shy, elusive monster said to lurk in its murky depths

rows.label: Lake Tanganyika
rows.description: lake between Tanzania, DR Congo, Burundi and Zambia
rows.hook: stretches longer than any other freshwater body on Earth

rows.label: Great Slave Lake
rows.description: lake in the Northwest Territories of Canada
rows.hook: freezes solid enough each winter for trucks to drive across on ice roads

rows.label: Lake Toba
rows.description: volcanic crater lake located in North Sumatra, Indonesia
rows.hook: contains a large island born from one of history's biggest volcanic eruptions

rows.label: Lake Garda
rows.description: lake in Italy
rows.hook: grows lemons along shores dotted with medieval castles

rows.label: Lake Champlain
rows.description: lake in New York, Vermont and Quebec
rows.hook: witnessed pivotal naval battles during a young nation's early wars

rows.label: Lake Constance
rows.description: lake in Germany, Switzerland and Austria
rows.hook: meets the borders of three countries at once

rows.label: Lake Geneva
rows.description: lake in Switzerland and France
rows.hook: shoots a giant fountain jet into the air along its shoreline

rows.label: Lake Okeechobee
rows.description: freshwater lake in the state of Florida, USA
rows.hook: feeds fresh water south into the Everglades, keeping the wetlands alive

rows.label: Great Bear Lake
rows.description: large glacial lake in the Northwest Territories, Canada
rows.hook: stays frozen for more than half the year and is prized for its exceptionally clear water

rows.label: Issyk-Kul
rows.description: lake in Kyrgyzstan
rows.hook: stays unfrozen year-round despite sitting high in cold mountains

rows.label: Lake Bled
rows.description: lake in Slovenia
rows.hook: centers on a tiny island church where visitors ring a wishing bell

rows.label: Loch Lomond
rows.description: freshwater lake in Scotland, UK
rows.hook: inspired a famous folk song about high roads and low roads

rows.label: Lake Malawi
rows.description: African Great Lake
rows.hook: shelters more fish species than almost any other body of water on Earth
